subtitle: AI Maturity Index — criteria and levels (Phase 2)

notice.rest: . Three of the seven dimensions (prompt quality, reuse, contribution) require analysis of conversation content — which depends on the Classification Engine and prior approval from Security, Governance, and DPO. We prefer to keep the screen transparent about this rather than display a number that could not be explained or defended.
notice.available: The four dimensions marked as available can already be measured with current data (usage metadata, Agents, MCP, and security detections) once the phase is approved.

n0.name: Not used
n0.description: No relevant evidence of use in the period.

n1.name: Explorer
n1.description: Simple requests, little context, and low reuse.

n2.name: User
n2.description: Frequent use with context and useful results.

n3.name: Advanced
n3.description: Structured prompts, appropriate choice of models/Agents.

n4.name: Specialist
n4.description: Integrates AI into processes and uses authorized tools/automation.

n5.name: Multiplier
n5.description: Creates standards, Agents, templates, and disseminates good practices.
